$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFRN (AIP France, chart dated 2026-02-19): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Rennes - Saint-Jacques

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: AD reserved for radio-equipped ACFT.
Reduced declared distances for take-off RWY 28 from TWY intersections: TWY A: TORA/TODA/ASDA = 1910 m; TWY B: TORA/TODA/ASDA = 1707 m; TWY C: TORA/TODA/ASDA = 1188 m.
Reduced declared distances for take-off RWY 10 from TWY intersections: TWY C: TORA/TODA/ASDA = 947 m; TWY D: TORA/TODA/ASDA = 1307 m.
Reduced declared distances for take-off RWY 32 from TWY G1 intersection: TORA/TODA/ASDA: 718 m.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
RWY 14 circuit must be respected as far as possible.
Final approches RWY 10 and 14/14L merged.
"Low height" circuits only on ATC authorization.
RWY 14/32: MNM 300 ft AAL Southern pattern.
RWY 10/28: MNM 500 ft AAL Northern pattern.
Training flights: MIL ACFT: prohibited between 2200 and 0800 local time.
TWY G restrictions: Part between commercial passengers APRON and ACB prohibited to ACFT with wingspan above 25 m.
Bypass G2: Use limited to light ACFT (< 1.5 t), code A (wingspan <= 15 m) and OMGWS <= 4.5 m.
Helicopters prohibited.
The bypass may only be used at the request of air traffic control.
TWY J unpaved: Reserved for light aviation ACFT < 1,5 t.
Right of way for the TWY G.
From 01 NOV to 15 APR: prohibited for ACFT; HEL with the largest overall dimension less than or equal to 12 m and with weight less than 3 T can air taxiing only and upon CTL authorization.
Run up areas: Under AD operator's agreement and with marshaller's assistance.
Freight area: West side of freight apron taxilane (facing West or East only).
Use of aprons Restriction for using the military apron: Heavy ACFT (MTOW > 7 t) entrance prohibited, except emergency situation diversion.; Light ACFT (MTOW < 7 t) PPR 24 HR on working days.
Commercial passenger and commercial freight apron: Mandatory parking for: all passenger and freight commercial flights; non-Shengen commercial and non-commercial flights.
At these stands, handling compulsory with PPR 48 HR.
General aviation and business operators can request With IFR traffic: Airplanes: VIS: 3000 m - Ceiling: 1000 ft.
Traffic patterns: 1500 ft MNM.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with secondary surveillance radar (see AD 1.0).

Aerobatics (NR 6365): See AIP ENR 5.5 Radio failure at arrival If failure occurs after CTR entry: In case entry instructions were communicated, follow the last received instructions.; Otherwise, fly AD overhead at 1500 ft AAL squawking 7600 before circuit entry.
Visual signals and pyrotechnic means are inoperative.
